title: Recovery
seo_description: Hyperice recovery at Hybrid Hub Newquay: Normatec compression, Hyperice X Knee contrast therapy and the Vyper vibrating roller.
intro: Take your recovery seriously with professional-grade Hyperice recovery technology at Hybrid Hub. Whether you're recovering after a hard session, preparing for the next one or simply giving your body some extra attention, our recovery zone gives you the tools to do it.
pay_note: Pay for your recovery slot via the WodBoard shop before use.

items.title: Normatec
items.text: Dynamic air compression designed to support circulation and help your legs feel refreshed after training.

items.title: Hyperice X Knee
items.text: Targeted contrast therapy, combining hot and cold treatment to support circulation, reduce soreness and aid recovery around the knee.

items.title: Vyper
items.text: A vibrating foam roller designed to help activate muscles, release tension and improve mobility.

closing_text: Make recovery part of your training routine.
